alt.en: A large gray cloud stands at the center of a gray floor. On the left, an open laptop with a small stack of papers in front of it sends a glowing dashed orange line carrying two packets up into the cloud. A small teal agent cube sits apart on the right, with no line to it.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一朵大型灰色云朵。左侧一台打开的笔记本电脑前放着一小叠文件，一条发光的橙色虚线带着两个数据包从电脑升入云中。右侧远处有一个小小的青绿色智能体方块，没有连线。

caption.en: Illustration: host information and credential-related files leave a computer for a collection endpoint along a path that runs apart from the agent, as in the backdoored-extension experiment CERT-EU describes. It does not depict CERT-EU's lab, the tested Pi or Claude Code harnesses, or a tested deployment.
caption.zh: 示意图：主机信息和与凭据有关的文件沿一条不经过智能体的路径，从电脑传往接收端，对应 CERT-EU 所述的扩展后门实验。图中并非 CERT-EU 的实验室、受测的 Pi 或 Claude Code 框架，也不代表任何经过测试的部署。

items.note: the collection endpoint, focal, at the center
the host whose environment and credential files were sent
the agent, small and secondary, off to the right, still chatting

links.note: starts at the top of the laptop's screen so the packets ride in open space, not behind the screen
